name: SPEEDRUNNER_ASI_REPLAY_SIDECAR_INTEGRATION_V1
purpose: Instrument the current public ASISleep candidate admission transaction with a durable replay sidecar while preserving existing proposal, replay, commit and revert behavior.

target_packet.claim_rule: Use transaction_only unless an exact environment replay-equivalence packet is available. Only then may replay_verified_admission be asserted.

zero_behavior_change_constraints: Do not change which traces qualify as successful.
Do not change LLM prompts, tools, generation settings, request limits or retry counts.
Do not change candidate function static validation.
Do not change lexical new-helper usage checking.
Do not change replay call ordering or fresh-environment construction.
Do not change env.execute_code or env.check_solution inputs.
Do not change the condition that replay mode commits only when all required replays pass.
Do not change the no-replay branch's static-validation commit behavior.

Provenance-write failure must be surfaced separately and must never be silently interpreted as replay success. For strict audit mode, fail closed before returning a newly committed codebook; for observation-only mode, preserve the algorithm result but mark provenance_incomplete outside the admission-proof claim.

minimal_signature_change.why: WakeSleepLoop already passes one unique per-batch path under run_dir/oracle_trace; making it explicit consumes an existing interface value rather than adding a new caller-visible channel.

canonical_digest_rules.json: UTF-8 JSON, sort_keys=true, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=false, terminal newline excluded from digest input.
canonical_digest_rules.codebook: Serialize the same semantic fields used by Codebook.save_json into the canonical JSON rule. If Codebook.save_json ordering/formatting is implementation-dependent, first build the equivalent in-memory object and canonicalize it; never hash a temporary filename or pretty-print representation.
canonical_digest_rules.trajectory: Canonical JSON array of exact ordered call strings after _asi_submit_test_trajectory cleaning and before _run_replay rewrites the final call into a local 'result =' assignment.
canonical_digest_rules.replay_result: Canonical JSON object containing task_id, solution_success, used_new_helper, error_class/error_text digest, and any captured reset/result evidence.
canonical_digest_rules.decision: Canonical JSON object over implementation/environment/transaction/replays plus status and post_codebook_sha256, excluding decision_packet_sha256 itself; digest this object to produce decision_packet_sha256.

field_mapping.implementation.revision: runtime/build supplied exact Git revision; do not infer from package version
field_mapping.implementation.asisleep_blob_sha: exact source blob of ASISleep implementation
field_mapping.implementation.policy_revision: a stable string identifying replay admission semantics; for the observed bytes use a project-local value such as speedrunner-asisleep-1f041a9b
field_mapping.environment.version: installed distribution version resolved at run start
field_mapping.environment.artifact_filename: installed wheel/sdist/JAR bundle identity source; never only package name
field_mapping.environment.artifact_sha256: hash of the exact distribution/JAR bundle used
field_mapping.environment.dataset_manifest_sha256: hash of the exact ordered ProblemLoader dataset record manifest used by the run
field_mapping.transaction.successful_task_ids: preserve deterministic order from successful traces; do not derive from the unordered successful_ids set
field_mapping.transaction.pre_codebook_sha256: canonical digest of incoming codebook before copy.deepcopy
field_mapping.transaction.candidate_codebook_sha256: canonical digest of state.codebook after proposal/static validation and before replay decision
field_mapping.transaction.candidate_functions: for each state.added_names entry, record exact function name and canonical source code sha256 from staged state.codebook
field_mapping.replays[].task_id: the successful task id being replayed
field_mapping.replays[].problem_record_sha256: canonical digest of the exact ProblemLoader record resolved for task_id
field_mapping.replays[].reset_observation_sha256: digest of reset observation/state evidence captured from the fresh replay environment before the scripted calls; if unavailable, do not assert replay_verified_admission
field_mapping.replays[].test_trajectory_artifact_sha25: sha256 of the persisted canonical trajectory artifact bytes
field_mapping.replays[].test_trajectory_digest: sha256 of canonical ordered call strings
field_mapping.replays[].error_class: null on clean pass; otherwise a stable class such as execution_error/check_solution_error/missing_helper/exception rather than free-form message alone
field_mapping.decision.status: commit on current all-pass path or current no-replay constructed-candidate path; revert on current missing/failed replay path
field_mapping.decision.post_codebook_sha256: candidate digest on commit; pre digest on revert
field_mapping.decision.decision_packet_sha256: canonical decision packet digest as defined above

required_code_hooks.action: Capture pre_codebook_sha256, explicit sleep_trace_path, exact experiment/source/environment bindings and an ordered successful task-id list.

After result=agent.run_sync and after confirming state.added_names is nonempty, capture candidate codebook digest and candidate function source digests. No candidate means no replay-admission transaction and therefore no v1 packet is required.
Before returning state.codebook, emit one transaction_only packet with allow_replay=false, replays=[], status=commit, and post=candidate.

Before returning original codebook, emit one transaction_only packet with allow_replay=true, all actually submitted replay records if any, status=revert, post=pre, plus a local diagnostic for missing task ids. The v1 semantic validator will correctly reject this as replay_verified_admission.
Persist exact ordered calls and a canonical replay-result artifact immediately after _run_replay returns; append its bound record to an in-memory replay list in successful-trace order.
Before returning original codebook, emit transaction_only unless an environment-equivalence packet exists; status=revert and post=pre.

Before returning state.codebook, emit transaction_only by default, or replay_verified_admission only when every successful task has exactly one replay record and environment replay equivalence is bound; status=commit and post=candidate.

ordering_fix_required_for_audit_only.observed_issue: Current code constructs successful_ids as a set and iterates that set for missing/replay checks. This does not change the logical all-pass predicate, but set iteration is not a durable ordered evidence identity.
ordering_fix_required_for_audit_only.instrumentation_rule: Keep successful_ids for membership semantics if desired, but separately retain successful_task_order=[t.id for t in successful]. Emit and iterate evidence records in that order. Do not claim the ordered replay_tasks==successful_task_ids validator condition from set order.

presentation_sidecar_boundary.observed_public_example: gh-pages public/methods/asi/epoch_0/sidecar.json records a selected Crafter evaluation trajectory and frame/call metrics.
presentation_sidecar_boundary.rule: Do not reuse the same semantic type name without a discriminator. A rollout/presentation sidecar is not an admission-proof sidecar. Recommended filenames: oracle_XXXX.replay_admission.json and oracle_XXXX.replay_trajectory.<task-id>.json.

historical_replay_boundary: This integration makes future runs auditable. It cannot retroactively create exact replay transcripts, environment hashes or Figure-12 numeric data for historical runs that did not persist them.
next_action: Search remaining public SpeedRunner gh-pages/project artifacts for ScienceWorld/Figure-12 data; if absent, treat future-run sidecar emission as fully specified and resume MemCompiler evaluated ScienceWorld run/memory snapshot binding.
